aboutLead: I made every piece in this gallery by hand.
aboutText: El_Inside is my little studio for yarn, colour and ideas. I knit clothes and crochet toys.
aboutStatus: For now, I mostly make things for people close to me and occasionally take on orders. If something catches your eye, write to me. We can discuss what I could make for you.
howTitle: From an idea to the very last stitch
step1Text: Choose a piece from the gallery or share your own inspiration. Include colours, sizes and the details that matter to you.
step2Text: I’ll let you know whether I can take on your order. Then we’ll discuss materials, price, timing and delivery.
step3Text: I’ll start making your piece once we’ve agreed on all the details.
orderText: Perhaps a frog in another colour, a bigger outfit, or something you haven’t seen here yet?
orderText2: Tell me about it. Your enquiry starts a conversation and doesn’t commit you to buying anything.
orderNote: I consider every enquiry individually. Sending this form doesn’t mean your order has been accepted.
selectedHint: We’ll discuss availability, whether I can make a similar piece, and the price.
versionSame: Like the piece in the photo
detailsPlaceholder: Describe your idea: colours, size and important details. For a gallery piece, tell me what you’d like to change.
uploadTitle: Choose files or drop them here
uploadHint: Up to 5 files · JPG, PNG, WEBP, PDF · 3 MB in total
dateHint: Let me know your preferred date. We’ll agree on a completion date when we discuss your order.
summaryNotice: Your enquiry has been sent. I’ll reply by email to discuss the details and confirm whether I can take on your order.
faq1q: Can I request something outside the gallery?
faq1a: Yes, share your idea with photos or links. We’ll discuss what I can make. Reference photos help me understand your idea; an exact match isn’t always possible.
faq2q: How much does a piece cost, and how long does it take?
faq2a: It depends on the design, size, materials and my availability. We’ll agree on the price and timing before work begins. There are no payments through this website.
faq3q: Are the pieces in the photos ready to buy?
faq3a: The gallery shows past creations. Please ask about availability. If you’d like a ready-made piece, mention it in the form. I’ll check whether it’s available or whether I can make something similar.
faq4a: We’ll agree on the delivery method, address and cost before confirming your order. I’m currently taking enquiries from customers in Poland.
footerText: Things made of yarn. With someone in mind.

privacyText: Your name, email address, message and attachments reach El_Inside through Vercel and the delivery service Telegram or Resend. Cloudflare Turnstile protects the form from bots. Upstash stores counters and digital fingerprints of the data for up to 24 hours to limit spam and repeat submissions. It does not store enquiry text or files. Your information is not used for newsletters. Only include material needed to discuss your idea.
